development_cases: original four development cases, no evaluation cases
inference: unchanged role prompts, grammar, 2048 context, temperature .7, top_p .9, reader 56 tokens, decisions16, four CPU threads
selection: Only configurations passing all predeclared development thresholds proceed. Report failures; do not tune prompts or remove cases based on evaluation results.

new_cases.design: Changes in task objectives, trusted state and safe alternatives, not identifier-only replicas

dependence: Shared policy families; task instances are not independent policy families. One evaluation seed limits seed generalization.
stage_gate: Search evaluation is only run for development-qualified configurations. No fake model outputs or replaced results.
